lines.zh: 沙地上横着走，脚都酸了。
lines.en: Walking sideways on sand tires my legs.
I scuttle faster than yesterday.
I'll rest once I cross this dune.
Sand crabs sidestep better than they walk.
Don't block me, I'm heading for wet sand.
These pebbles prick every step.

lines.zh: 这段沙路我闭着眼也爬得。
lines.en: I could cross this stretch blind.

lines.zh: 我的小钳子下面藏着沙。
lines.en: Sand hides under my little claws.
Who churned up the sand like this?
Salt smell past the dunes.
Out of the sand, and back into it.
A little crab follows me sideways.
Who pushed this shell to my burrow?
I burrow into sand and vanish.
Where the tide retreats, I follow.
That hiss is wind combing the dunes.
My shadow walks sideways.
How many grains have I counted?

lines.zh: 我挖的洞，只够藏一只钳。
lines.en: My burrow fits only one claw.
Too much sun; I'll sink my eyes in the sand.
Sand… it's all sand.

lines.zh: 我在想沙丘那边有多干。
lines.en: I wonder how dry it is past the dune.

lines.zh: 沙底下闷，我出来透一口。
lines.en: It is close under the sand; I come up for air.
The sun warms my shell; I won't budge.
Night sand is cool against my shell.
I'm waiting for the tide to reach my burrow.
This cactus patch is a wall.

lines.zh: 洞口那块石头晒得真暖。
lines.en: The stone at my burrow is warm.
Has the sun bleached my shell?

lines.zh: 我横着走，沙粒在壳上响。
lines.en: I walk sideways, sand ticking my shell.
Sand Crab? I'll remember that.
Your breath is louder than the tide.

lines.zh: 你这么高，潮水也淹不到你。
lines.en: You stand so tall the tide can't reach you.

lines.zh: 你走不直，我倒觉得亲切。
lines.en: You can't walk straight; I like that.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，不知该夹还是跑。
lines.en: I raise my claw, unsure whether to pinch or run.

lines.zh: 你的靴子里全是沙，我看见。
lines.en: Your boots are full of sand; I can see it.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙太烫，我往湿处挪。
lines.en: Desert sand burns; I shift to the damp.

lines.zh: 你身上有沙漠正午的热气。
lines.en: You carry the heat of a desert noon.

lines.zh: 你的影子投下来，我缩进沙。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 你手里的光，晃得我壳发白。
lines.en: The light in your hand bleaches my shell.
The pain sends me scuttling sideways.
Sand on my shell hides the wound.
You crushed my claw.

lines.zh: 我横着走，你从正面撞来。
lines.en: I sideways-step; you hit me head-on.
My shell cracked and sand is getting in.

lines.zh: 沙蟹的壳，被踩得咯吱响。
lines.en: My shell creaks when stepped on.
Back off, my claw is still raised.
My claw will remember your foot.
I can't crawl; the sand feels heavy.
One of my walking legs is broken.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我不敢凑太近。
lines.en: Smells like carrion, but I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着，只露一排眼睛。
lines.en: Buried in sand, only my eye row shows.
I go sideways into the sand hole.
Just one small piece, then I go.
I smelled it across the dunes.
I burrow in sand with only my eyes out.
I reach out a claw and touch it first.

lines.zh: 我是不是太好骗，沙里没吃的。
lines.en: Am I too gullible? There is no food in the sand.
Can I come just a bit closer?

lines.zh: 沙里的小蟹，嘴里比脑子快。
lines.en: A little crab in sand: my mouth outruns my wits.

lines.zh: 我的壳经不起你这一脚。
lines.en: My shell can't take a kick like that.
Sand is stuck in my shell joints.
You knocked my claw out of line.
You stepped on one of my walking legs.
You press down and the sand gives way.

lines.zh: 沙蟹在沙下吐泡，一碰就碎。
lines.en: Sand crabs bubble under sand; touch breaks them.

lines.zh: 别把我踢进仙人掌丛里。
lines.en: Don't kick me into the cactus patch.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我挖的洞塌了半边。
lines.en: One bump and half my burrow caved in.

lines.zh: 你没看见沙面上有只蟹？
lines.en: Didn't you see a crab on the sand?
Excuse me, I can't hurry sideways.

lines.zh: 看你横着走来，我心就软。
lines.en: Watching you scuttle makes me soft.

lines.zh: 我夹来一片最白的贝壳。
lines.en: I brought the whitest shell I could find.
The sun warms my sand-crab shell.
Behind the dune, I dug a hole.

lines.zh: 我敲壳的声音，你听见吗？
lines.en: Do you hear me tapping my shell?
This sand ridge is ours.
This tide season, I want only you.
Your shell is the color of sunburnt sand.

lines.zh: 这些卵，我们一起埋进沙。
lines.en: We'll bury these eggs in the sand together.
Let's scuttle side by side till dawn.
I'll drag it deep into my burrow.

lines.zh: 这贝壳滚到我钳子边了。
lines.en: This shell rolled right up to my claw.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，只露出两只眼。
lines.en: Beneath the sand, only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 钳子夹着，走一步歪一步。
lines.en: I wobble a step for every one I take.

lines.zh: 浪打上来一个，我横着夹住。
lines.en: A wave brings one; I take it sideways.

lines.zh: 这个也许能换条小鱼干。
lines.en: Maybe I can trade this for dried fish.
My claw can't crack this stone.

lines.zh: 沙漠里怎么会有这种东西？
lines.en: What is this doing in the desert?
This shell might serve as a bowl.
It fits right at my burrow mouth.
This one will feed me till dark.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就横着冲过去。
lines.en: At three, I charge sideways.
The claw closes and stays closed.
I run sideways faster than you think.
Blink and you miss me — I'm quick.
The sand stirs — that's it.
The claw grabs the meanest one first.
I dug a tunnel through this sand.
The sand shifts and out come my claws.
I've guarded this burrow all night.

lines.zh: 沙里的事，我从不半途放手。
lines.en: In sand, I never let go halfway.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出来，只露出两只眼。
lines.en: I rise from the sand, only my eyes showing.
Chasing you beats chasing gulls.
This beach is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 沙里的小虫，力气快没了。
lines.en: The little bug in the sand is almost spent.
Run — there's no cover in this sand.

lines.zh: 这沙下每条洞我都钻过。
lines.en: I know every tunnel under this sand.
My shell is the color of sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的螃蟹，也会横着冲。
lines.en: Desert crabs charge sideways too.
The sand you stepped on is still warm.
Back away from my burrow.
Stay away from my nest under the sand.

lines.zh: 我的钳子就是尾巴的延续。
lines.en: My claw is my tail's reach.

lines.zh: 沙漠没有珊瑚，只有我的壳。
lines.en: No coral in the desert — only my shell.
One pinch and you'll know pain.
That pinch mark will last till morning.
My claw is made for toes.
I nipped you; tastes of salt.
My claw bites harder than teeth.
My claw hasn't used its full strength.

lines.zh: 沙粒底下，我也许还没长大。
lines.en: Under the grains, maybe I'm not grown yet.
The pool in the sand. Just arrived.
I drill sideways out of the sand.

lines.zh: 刚从沙下的卵里爬出来。
lines.en: Just crawled out of an egg under the sand.

lines.zh: 正午的沙烫，我先躲一躲。
lines.en: The noon sand burns, so I hide first.
So quiet there isn't even a wave.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘底下钻出来了。
lines.en: I've dug my way out from under the dune.
First, shake the sand off my shell.
I just crawled out of the wet sand.
The tide just left; the sand is still cool.
Hot! The sand is smoking!
The dune slipped and I rolled to the bottom.
I… got pulled into deep water.

lines.zh: 海边的爆炸，把我的洞震塌了。
lines.en: That blast on the shore caved my burrow in.
An arrow grazed my shell.
This curse is crawling into my shell seams.

lines.zh: 沙里连一点碎壳都没有。
lines.en: Not a shell fragment left in this sand.
Lightning hit the sand and my shell went numb.
Down here there isn't even sand.
